name: Cyclone Kiran
location: Arabian Sea, approaching Sindh coast and Karachi, Pakistan
impact: Landfall expected near Karachi on July 3rd. Approximately 77,743 people in the immediate zone and ~972,501 in the wider region are affected. Infrastructure damage includes 124 hospitals, 2,517 schools, and 4,761 settlements.
context: Driven by La Niña conditions causing Sea Surface Temperature (SST) anomalies of 2–4°C in the Arabian Sea, the cyclone formed in late June 2025. It intensified rapidly from a Low-Pressure System on June 27th to a Category 3 storm by July 2nd. The system tracked southwest of Thatta and is projected to make landfall near Karachi on July 3rd. The event involves a massive population exposure of 22.2 million across 5 districts.
